# Indonesia OpenSourceRail Campaign
<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-marketing-campaigns.py. -->

National outreach package covering **2 catalogued cities**. Values
below aggregate city screening models; the national brief separately treats the
shared manufacturing plant.

## Audience

- Indonesia ministry responsible for transport and urban mobility
- Indonesia national climate, energy or Green Climate Fund authority
- Indonesia public investment, planning or finance authority
- Embassy or High Commission of Indonesia in the United Kingdom — economic section

## National proposition

| Measure | Catalogue result |
|---|---:|
| Population represented | 5,624,000 |
| Lines / route length | 15 / 539 km |
| Fleet | 782 trainsets |
| City programme CAPEX | $5.67 B |
| Local capital and value allocation | $4.24 B (75%) |
| Station/depot PV / storage | 61.0 MW / 381.5 MWh |
| Illustrative external-capital saving | $8.78 B |

Lead with a government-reviewed pilot, local manufacturing and construction,
open standards, renewable-energy integration and independently checked demand,
environmental, social and engineering studies.
